Beta_Diversity_PD_Final_Version

2026-04-15

Load the data

metadata = read.delim('parkinsons_metadata.txt', row.names = 1) 
taxonomy = read.delim('taxonomy.tsv', row.names = 1) 
counts = read.delim('feature-table.txt', skip=1, row.names=1)

PART 1: Make a Phyloseq object

# Wrangle Taxonomy Table
taxonomy_formatted <- taxonomy %>%
  separate(col = Taxon,
           into = c('Domain', 'Phylum', 'Class', 'Order', 'Family', 
                               'Genus', 'Species'),
           sep = ';', fill = 'right') %>%
  select(-Confidence) %>%
  as.matrix()

# Wrangle Counts Table
counts_formatted <- counts %>% as.matrix()

# Wrangle Metadata Table:
# Extract Column Names
meta_names <- read.delim('parkinsons_metadata.txt', row.names = 1) %>% names()

# Extract Data
meta_data <- read.delim('parkinsons_metadata.txt', row.names = 1, skip = 1, header = F)

# Ensure all values in the first row of real data are identical
table(metadata[1,] == meta_data[1,])
## 
## TRUE 
##   85
# Set column names for metadata
names(meta_data) = meta_names

# Creating the phyloseq object
ps = phyloseq(sample_data(meta_data),
               otu_table(counts_formatted, taxa_are_rows = T),
               tax_table(taxonomy_formatted))

# Filter for Parkinson's Disease only
ps_PD <- subset_samples(ps, Disease == "PD")

# Remove taxa that are now zero after subsetting
ps_PD <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_PD) > 0, ps_PD)

# Saving phyloseq object for later reference if needed
saveRDS(ps_PD, 'phyloseq_taxonomy.rds')

# Visualize sequencing depth
hist(sample_sums(ps_PD))

# Rarefaction curves
rarecurve(t(data.frame(ps@otu_table)),
          step = 500)
## Warning in rarecurve(t(data.frame(ps@otu_table)), step = 500): most observed
## count data have counts 1, but smallest count is 2

# Rarefy
set.seed(13)
psrare <- rarefy_even_depth(ps_PD, sample.size = 5103, rngseed = 13)
## `set.seed(13)` was used to initialize repeatable random subsampling.
## Please record this for your records so others can reproduce.
## Try `set.seed(13); .Random.seed` for the full vector
## ...
## 3 samples removedbecause they contained fewer reads than `sample.size`.
## Up to first five removed samples are:
## F2919F6445F7160
## ...
## 526OTUs were removed because they are no longer 
## present in any sample after random subsampling
## ...
table(sample_sums(psrare))
## 
## 5103 
##  194
ps_bray <- phyloseq::distance(psrare, method = "bray")

library(vegan)
library(tibble)

mds <- metaMDS(ps_bray)
## Run 0 stress 0.2553388 
## Run 1 stress 0.280247 
## Run 2 stress 0.2761471 
## Run 3 stress 0.2671092 
## Run 4 stress 0.2571365 
## Run 5 stress 0.2597398 
## Run 6 stress 0.2749759 
## Run 7 stress 0.2736539 
## Run 8 stress 0.2549409 
## ... New best solution
## ... Procrustes: rmse 0.01589558  max resid 0.1110104 
## Run 9 stress 0.2622983 
## Run 10 stress 0.2619387 
## Run 11 stress 0.2666514 
## Run 12 stress 0.2543264 
## ... New best solution
## ... Procrustes: rmse 0.008621673  max resid 0.07373266 
## Run 13 stress 0.2673716 
## Run 14 stress 0.2661125 
## Run 15 stress 0.2741007 
## Run 16 stress 0.2609169 
## Run 17 stress 0.2617467 
## Run 18 stress 0.2712104 
## Run 19 stress 0.2724453 
## Run 20 stress 0.2635988 
## *** Best solution was not repeated -- monoMDS stopping criteria:
##      2: no. of iterations >= maxit
##     18: stress ratio > sratmax
# Extract NMDS coordinates
mds_data <- as.data.frame(mds$points)
mds_data$SampleID <- rownames(mds_data)

# Merge metadata
metadata <- sample_data(psrare) %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID")

mds_data <- merge(mds_data, metadata, by = "SampleID")

library(ggplot2)

beta_plot <- ggplot(mds_data,
                    aes(x = MDS1, y = MDS2,
                        colour = Lived_on_farm)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  stat_ellipse(type = "t") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(colour = "Lived on Farm") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
beta_plot

ggsave(filename = "beta_plot.png", plot = beta_plot, width = 6, height = 4)

stats_univar <- adonis2(ps_bray ~ Lived_on_farm,
                        data = metadata,
                        permutations = 999)
print(stats_univar)
## Permutation test for adonis under reduced model
## Permutation: free
## Number of permutations: 999
## 
## adonis2(formula = ps_bray ~ Lived_on_farm, data = metadata, permutations = 999)

## Model      1    0.308 0.0049 0.9462  0.558
## Residual 192   62.487 0.9951              
## Total    193   62.795 1.0000
